decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan and 11686/1/11 Rev C received: 07/08/2018.
11686/2/12 Rev N received: 12/09/2018.
11686/2/13 Rev F2, 11686/2/15 Rev F2, and Daikin VAM-FC Ventilation Technical Data, received: 26/09/2018.
Specification of Elma RM 90 Watch Cleaning Machine received: 27/09/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for a Valuation and Safe Deposit Shop shall not be carried on outside the following times: Monday - Sunday 08:00 - 21:00.

Condition : 4 - The access doorway to the ground floor A1 unit shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
description: Change of use of the ground floor and basement from A1 Retail to Valuation and Safe Deposit Shop (Sui Generis)
